metrics.metric: Absolute Financial Performance (year-over-year growth of adjusted net income)
metrics.evidence: Absolute Financial Performance (25% Weighting) | Reflects year-over-year growth of Intel's net income or adjusted net income

metrics.metric: Relative Financial Performance (net income growth vs. technology peer companies)
metrics.evidence: Relative Financial Performance (25% Weighting) | Reflects Intel's year-over-year net income or adjusted net income growth compared with the net income or adjusted net income growth of technology peer companies
Operational Performance (50% Weighting) | Reflects specific operational goals that the committee approves for each business unit
